description: Skeletal sector, compartment, laterality and sex-layer hover payloads. Universal labels; every number cites sources/bone-volume-sources.md.
mesh_policy: Reuse BodyParts3D-derived meshes (ashemag/human-atlas, slorksmo/Human-Atlas, Z-Anatomy). Sectors = clip/shader bands on existing bone meshes; do not create new meshes. Keep CC BY / CC BY-SA attribution.

hover.title: Mostly sponge
hover.summary: A thin shell around a big trabecular core.

numbers.text: Near endplates trabecular bone carries 76–89% of load

hover.title: The thin top-back wall
hover.summary: Hip fractures start where the neck cortex is thinnest.

hover.title: Shell vs sponge
hover.summary: TV = the box, BV = the bone in it, BV/TV = how full. Shell = Ct.V, sponge = Tb.V.

hover.title: Outside grows, inside hollows
hover.summary: Over life the outer surface creeps out while the inner wall is eaten away: wider tube, thinner wall.

hover.title: Arms lean right
hover.summary: Most people's right arm bones are a little wider. Over 10% is not rare. Mild asymmetry is normal, not disease.

numbers.text: Tennis playing arm: cortical area +12–32%, density ≈ same
Throwers keep 55.5% of size benefit after 50+ y

hover.title: Legs nearly match
hover.summary: Leg bones are close to symmetric, with a tiny left tilt in shaft width.

hover.title: Two hips, two scores
hover.summary: Hips agree closely on average, but over half of people differ by more than scanner noise.

numbers.text: 7% of osteopenic-spine patients had one osteoporotic hip

sex_layer.atlas: slorksmo/Human-Atlas (male + female reference bodies); ashemag/human-atlas is male-only BodyParts3D
sex_layer.scope_note: bone-metric sex differences only; reproductive anatomy owned by other themes

female.summary: Peak total-body bone mineral ≈ age 18. Ageing loses trabecular struts.

male.summary: Peak ≈ age 20. Wider bones. Ageing mainly thins struts.

numbers.text: Bone areas 35–42% larger than young women
Young-adult Tb BV/TV +26%, Tb.Th +28% vs women (wrist)

both.text: ≈39% of young-adult total-body BMC laid down in the 4 years around peak height velocity
Tb BV/TV declines similarly: −27% W / −26% M

gaps: No per-third whole-bone Ct.V/Tb.V human table found; sector hovers use site ratios
Leg L/R values are caliper breadths, not volumes
